entities.summary: Susanto Megaranto (b. 1987-10-08, Indramayu) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Indramayu and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
